Lower bar slowly with control, resisting gravity.

Lower under control over 3 seconds to full extension.

cycle_4.title: Thursday: Cardio + Mobility

exercises.exerciseName: 5 to 10 KM Aerobic Running or Walking
instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.
Lock into conversational aerobic pace (heart rate approx 120-140 bpm).
Run or briskly walk for the complete 5.0 to 10.0 KM distance.
Strict program protocol: No weight training or heavy lifting allowed on cardio day.
Hydrate well and take full muscular rest after session.
Start in high plank, push hips up and back into Downward Dog.
Pedal heels gently to stretch calves and hamstrings.
Roll forward through spine into Cobra, gently lifting chest.
Breathe deeply into diaphragm and flow smoothly between positions.
Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale, arch spine gently downward, open chest and look upward (Cow).
Exhale, round upper spine toward ceiling, tuck chin and tailbone (Cat).
Move smoothly in coordination with diaphragmatic breathing.
Step into deep lunge with both hands inside front foot.
Drop back knee or keep elevated for active stretch.
Rotate inside arm open toward ceiling, following hand with eyes.
Place hand down and shift weight back to stretch front hamstring.
Perform 5 continuous flows per side.
Kneel on floor with big toes touching and knees comfortably spread.
Fold forward at hips, extending arms out along floor in front of you.
Rest forehead on mat and sink hips back onto heels.
Take 10 slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths.

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.

Drive through front heel to step forward into next stride.

cycle_4.title: Thursday: Cardio + Mobility

exercises.exerciseName: 5 to 10 KM Aerobic Running or Walking
instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.
Lock into conversational aerobic pace (heart rate approx 120-140 bpm).
Run or briskly walk for the complete 5.0 to 10.0 KM distance.
Strict program protocol: No weight training or heavy lifting allowed on cardio day.
Hydrate well and take full muscular rest after session.
Start in high plank, push hips up and back into Downward Dog.
Pedal heels gently to stretch calves and hamstrings.
Roll forward through spine into Cobra, gently lifting chest.
Breathe deeply into diaphragm and flow smoothly between positions.
Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale, arch spine gently downward, open chest and look upward (Cow).
Exhale, round upper spine toward ceiling, tuck chin and tailbone (Cat).
Move smoothly in coordination with diaphragmatic breathing.
Stand tall, hold wall for balance if required.
Grasp right ankle with right hand behind you.
Keep knees aligned and gently squeeze right glute to deepen hip flexor stretch.
Hold for 45 seconds per side without arching lower back.

Lower chest smoothly toward bench.
Press firmly away to contract chest.

instructions: Kneel on floor with big toes touching and knees comfortably spread.
Fold forward at hips, extending arms out along floor in front of you.
Rest forehead on mat and sink hips back onto heels.
Take 10 slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths.
Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale, arch spine gently downward, open chest and look upward (Cow).
Exhale, round upper spine toward ceiling, tuck chin and tailbone (Cat).
Move smoothly in coordination with diaphragmatic breathing.
Lie flat on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee.
Reach through and pull thigh toward chest.
Keep head and shoulders relaxed on mat.
Breathe deeply into hip tension for 45 seconds each side.
Stand tall, hold wall for balance if required.
Grasp right ankle with right hand behind you.
Keep knees aligned and gently squeeze right glute to deepen hip flexor stretch.
Hold for 45 seconds per side without arching lower back.

instructions: Set hands slightly wider than shoulders in high plank position.
Lock glutes and pull navel into spine to maintain rigid plank line.
Lower chest smoothly until touching or hovering 1 inch from floor.
Press floor away with palms and flare lats at top.
Maintain steady breathing: inhale on descent, exhale on press.
Place hands on elevated surface wider than shoulders.
Lower chest smoothly toward bench.
Press firmly away to contract chest.

Elevate feet on bench or bed while planting hands shoulder-width on floor.
Maintain neutral cervical spine and rigid torso.
Lower chest smoothly toward floor.
Press up powerfully, squeezing clavicular head of pectorals at top.
Position hands together directly beneath chest forming diamond shape.
Keep body in rigid plank with glutes and abs engaged.
Lower chest under control until sternum grazes fingers.
Press through palms, extending elbows fully to contract triceps.
Hands grip edge of chair shoulder-width apart.
Lower hips downward by flexing elbows behind you.

cycle_2.title: Tuesday: Core & Abs Shred

instructions: Place forearms on floor with elbows directly beneath shoulders.
Step feet back hip-width apart into plank position.
Tuck tailbone under and contract abdominals as if bracing for a punch.
Keep neck neutral looking at floor between hands.
Hold for prescribed time without letting hips sag or pike.
Lie on back with hands lightly behind head without pulling on neck.
Lift shoulder blades off floor and bring knees to 90 degrees.
Rotate right elbow toward left knee while extending right leg straight.
Switch sides smoothly with controlled cadence, rotating left elbow to right knee.
Maintain continuous tension on obliques throughout.
Sit on floor with knees bent and feet elevated.
Lean back slightly to engage core into V-sit angle.
Rotate shoulders and chest from right to left.
Touch floor on each side beside hip.
Focus rotation through ribcage, not just swinging hands.

cycle_3.title: Wednesday: Lower Body & Legs

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.
Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees.
Descend smoothly until hip crease drops parallel to knees.
Keep heels glued to the floor and spine neutral.
Drive through heels and mid-foot to return to full extension.
Take a controlled step forward with lead leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee hovers an inch above ground.
Maintain upright torso and tight core.
Drive through front heel to step forward into next stride.
Back flat against sturdy wall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to ground (90° at knee and hip).
Knees track directly over ankles, not forward past toes.
Breathe rhythmically and resist leaning forward with torso.
Stand tall with core braced and hands near a wall for balance.
Press down through big toes and balls of feet to elevate heels high.
Squeeze calves tight at the top for 1 full second.
Descend slowly over 2 seconds to stretch the Achilles tendon.
Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted flat hip-width apart.
Press through heels and contract glutes hard to lift hips toward ceiling.
Ensure ribs stay pulled down to avoid lower back hyper-extension.
Hold peak contraction for a deliberate 2-count.
Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.

instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.

Lower chest smoothly toward bench.
Press firmly away to contract chest.

Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.

Drive through front heel to step forward into next stride.

Tuck tailbone under and contract abdominals as if bracing for a punch.

cycle_3.title: Wednesday: Quads + Glutes

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.
Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees.
Descend smoothly until hip crease drops parallel to knees.
Keep heels glued to the floor and spine neutral.
Drive through heels and mid-foot to return to full extension.
Back flat against sturdy wall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to ground (90° at knee and hip).
Knees track directly over ankles, not forward past toes.
Breathe rhythmically and resist leaning forward with torso.
Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted flat hip-width apart.
Press through heels and contract glutes hard to lift hips toward ceiling.
Ensure ribs stay pulled down to avoid lower back hyper-extension.
Hold peak contraction for a deliberate 2-count.
Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.
Stand tall with core braced and hands near a wall for balance.
Press down through big toes and balls of feet to elevate heels high.
Squeeze calves tight at the top for 1 full second.
Descend slowly over 2 seconds to stretch the Achilles tendon.
Stand tall, hold wall for balance if required.
Grasp right ankle with right hand behind you.
Keep knees aligned and gently squeeze right glute to deepen hip flexor stretch.
Hold for 45 seconds per side without arching lower back.

cycle_4.title: Thursday: Cardio + Core + Mobility

exercises.exerciseName: 5 to 10 KM Aerobic Running or Walking
instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.
Lock into conversational aerobic pace (heart rate approx 120-140 bpm).
Run or briskly walk for the complete 5.0 to 10.0 KM distance.
Strict program protocol: No weight training or heavy lifting allowed on cardio day.
Hydrate well and take full muscular rest after session.
Start in strong push-up plank position.
Drive right knee rapidly toward chest, keeping foot off floor.
Quickly step back while driving left knee forward.
Maintain flat hips and steady running cadence.
Keep core braced and breathing rhythmic.
Place forearms on floor with elbows directly beneath shoulders.
Step feet back hip-width apart into plank position.
Tuck tailbone under and contract abdominals as if bracing for a punch.
Keep neck neutral looking at floor between hands.
Hold for prescribed time without letting hips sag or pike.
Kneel on floor with big toes touching and knees comfortably spread.
Fold forward at hips, extending arms out along floor in front of you.
Rest forehead on mat and sink hips back onto heels.
Take 10 slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths.

cycle_3.title: Wednesday: Quads + Glutes

instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.
Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees.
Descend smoothly until hip crease drops parallel to knees.
Keep heels glued to the floor and spine neutral.
Drive through heels and mid-foot to return to full extension.
Back flat against sturdy wall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Slide down until thighs are parallel to ground (90° at knee and hip).
Knees track directly over ankles, not forward past toes.
Breathe rhythmically and resist leaning forward with torso.
Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted flat hip-width apart.
Press through heels and contract glutes hard to lift hips toward ceiling.
Ensure ribs stay pulled down to avoid lower back hyper-extension.
Hold peak contraction for a deliberate 2-count.
Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.
Stand tall with core braced and hands near a wall for balance.
Press down through big toes and balls of feet to elevate heels high.
Squeeze calves tight at the top for 1 full second.
Descend slowly over 2 seconds to stretch the Achilles tendon.
Stand tall, hold wall for balance if required.
Grasp right ankle with right hand behind you.
Keep knees aligned and gently squeeze right glute to deepen hip flexor stretch.
Hold for 45 seconds per side without arching lower back.

cycle_4.title: Thursday: Cardio + Core + Mobility

exercises.exerciseName: 5 to 10 KM Aerobic Running or Walking
instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.
Lock into conversational aerobic pace (heart rate approx 120-140 bpm).
Run or briskly walk for the complete 5.0 to 10.0 KM distance.
Strict program protocol: No weight training or heavy lifting allowed on cardio day.
Hydrate well and take full muscular rest after session.
Start in strong push-up plank position.
Drive right knee rapidly toward chest, keeping foot off floor.
Quickly step back while driving left knee forward.
Maintain flat hips and steady running cadence.
Keep core braced and breathing rhythmic.
Place forearms on floor with elbows directly beneath shoulders.
Step feet back hip-width apart into plank position.
Tuck tailbone under and contract abdominals as if bracing for a punch.
Keep neck neutral looking at floor between hands.
Hold for prescribed time without letting hips sag or pike.
Kneel on floor with big toes touching and knees comfortably spread.
Fold forward at hips, extending arms out along floor in front of you.
Rest forehead on mat and sink hips back onto heels.
Take 10 slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths.

instructions: Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted flat hip-width apart.
Press through heels and contract glutes hard to lift hips toward ceiling.

Hold peak contraction for a deliberate 2-count.
Lower hips smoothly until glutes lightly tap the mat, then repeat.
Take a controlled step forward with lead leg.
Lower hips until front thigh is parallel to floor and back knee hovers an inch above ground.

Drive through front heel to step forward into next stride.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and chest proud.
Initiate movement by sending hips back and bending knees.
Descend smoothly until hip crease drops parallel to knees.

Lower rear knee toward floor in a controlled vertical path.
Keep front foot flat and knee tracking over second toe.
Press through front mid-foot and heel to return upright.
Lie flat on back, cross one ankle over opposite knee.
Reach through and pull thigh toward chest.
Keep head and shoulders relaxed on mat.
Breathe deeply into hip tension for 45 seconds each side.

cycle_6.title: Saturday: Walking + Mobility

exercises.exerciseName: 5 to 10 KM Aerobic Running or Walking
instructions: Begin with 3 minutes of brisk walking to elevate core temperature.
Lock into conversational aerobic pace (heart rate approx 120-140 bpm).
Run or briskly walk for the complete 5.0 to 10.0 KM distance.
Strict program protocol: No weight training or heavy lifting allowed on cardio day.
Hydrate well and take full muscular rest after session.
Start in high plank, push hips up and back into Downward Dog.
Pedal heels gently to stretch calves and hamstrings.
Roll forward through spine into Cobra, gently lifting chest.
Breathe deeply into diaphragm and flow smoothly between positions.
Hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
Inhale, arch spine gently downward, open chest and look upward (Cow).
Exhale, round upper spine toward ceiling, tuck chin and tailbone (Cat).
Move smoothly in coordination with diaphragmatic breathing.
Stand tall, hold wall for balance if required.
Grasp right ankle with right hand behind you.
Keep knees aligned and gently squeeze right glute to deepen hip flexor stretch.
Hold for 45 seconds per side without arching lower back.
